title: Milab abductee meets a Nordic on a military base: 'by degrees'

tellings.quote: she asked the Nordic if they were involved with the grace and the reply of the Nordic was by degrees.

plain: A woman who says she was taken by military personnel as well as by aliens (abductees call this a "milab") tells of meeting a "Nordic," a tall, human-looking alien, on a military base. She asked whether the Nordics were involved with the Greys, the small grey aliens of abduction stories, and the answer was "by degrees." The researcher Tim Alberino tells Michels this from the abduction researcher Karla Turner's book Taken. If true, it would mean different kinds of beings are working with each other, and with the military.
